niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency for every advertiser — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, target markets, creative needs, and whether you want programmatic buying, direct-sold placements, attribution/measurement, or creative production.

Quick framework and recommended names by need

- Large-scale brand campaigns / full-service media planning and buying
  - Leading holding-group agencies (strong cross-channel CTV capability): GroupM (Mindshare, Wavemaker, Essence), Omnicom (OMD, PHD), Publicis (Starcom, Zenith), Dentsu (Carat, iProspect).
  - Why: scale, publisher relationships, measurement teams, integrated TV/digital strategies.

- Programmatic CTV buying and tech-forward execution
  - The Trade Desk (DSP), Amobee, Magnite (SSP/player-side), Xandr/other programmatic partners.
  - Why: advanced targeting, bidding control, audience optimization.

- Performance / direct-response CTV
  - Specialist performance shops (examples: Tinuiti, 3Q Digital, other digital performance agencies that now offer CTV).
  - Why: ROI-focused creative, strong measurement and attribution to lower-funnel KPIs.

- Creative and dynamic CTV ad production & personalization
  - Innovid, Celtra, creative agencies with CTV experience.
  - Why: CTV-specific formats, dynamic creatives, interactive/ATV capabilities and testing.

- TV/advanced-audience specialists (CTV-first)
  - Simulmedia, Cadent and other advanced-TV platforms/shops.
  - Why: audience-driven TV planning that blends linear and CTV.

How I can help next
If you tell me:
- Budget (monthly or campaign)
- Geographies (US, EMEA, APAC, local)
- Primary KPI (brand awareness, reach/frequency, clicks/sales, ROAS)
- Whether you need creative production or only media buying

I’ll give a tailored shortlist of 3–5 agencies/platforms (with pros, cons, and what to expect cost- and capability-wise). Which of those details can you share?
